<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /home/user/RSI && python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate 52^12
result = 52 ** 12
print(f"52^12 = {result}")

# Convert to string to get individual digits
result_str = str(result)
print(f"Number of digits: {len(result_str)}")
print(f"Digits: {result_str}")

# Sum the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in result_str)
print(f"\nSum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
